name: Crizotinib
mechanism: First-in-class ATP-competitive inhibitor of ALK, ROS1 and MET (originally developed as a MET inhibitor). Limited CNS penetration owing to P-glycoprotein efflux.
interactions: CYP3A4 substrate and moderate inhibitor; avoid strong CYP3A inhibitors/inducers and caution with QT-prolonging drugs.
resistance: ALK L1196M gatekeeper, G1269A and other mutations; ROS1 G2032R; CNS progression due to poor penetration; bypass activation.
